about_the_game:
Contents include:
- Zeref as a playable character
Allows players to add Black Wizard Zeref to their party as a playable character after Bonus Chapter 1.
- Character Story
Zeref's special story will be unlocked via character progression.
- A total of 4 outfit specific to Zeref
・ Zeref's outfit "Luxury Restaurant"
・ Zeref's outfit "Happy Wedding"
・ Zeref's outfit "Fairy School"
・ Zeref's outfit "Emperor Spriggan"

Note:
- The four outfits will be unlocked when Zeref is added to the player's party.
- Characters' outfits can be changed from the Characters screen. (The character must be a party member.)
- Content can be accessed after reaching a designated point in the game.
- Please see the official site for more details.
- This product is eligible content for the "FAIRY TAIL 2 Season Pass." Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
